commit.subject: LU-20923 ofd: prepare for larger bulk buffer sizes
commit.message:
LU-20923 ofd: prepare for larger bulk buffer sizes

ofd_preprw_read() and ofd_preprw_write() should gracefully handle
niobuf descriptors that exceed the current limits, since they are
expected to grow larger as network bandwidth increases.

Signed-off-by: Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: I40c679834c45d24a3b14330fa05b8849923ebbe5
